'''Mitis''' was a [[Nomai]] from [[Brittle Hollow]] who lived in the [[Hanging City]]. They became involved in a discussion on how to obtain an advanced warp core for the [[Ash Twin Project]]. When [[Spire]] argued that abandoning [[the Vessel]]'s warp core would mean losing valuable knowledge, Mitis proposed that it would be best to relearn how to make an advanced warp core as there was little hope of recovering this knowledge.<ref>SPIRE: Abandoning the Vessel’s warp core and its casing means losing valuable knowledge. MITIS: This is true; however, it’s knowledge we have little hope of recovering. It would be best to relearn, I think.</ref>

== Trivia ==

* The ''[[Wikipedia:Caryota mitis|crayota mitis]]'', or fishtail palm, is a palm native to Tropical Asia.
